title: Open Sign
intro: Oh, hi! You must be the new sign maker. I'm Tom, I run the flower shop next to Rosa's bakery.
Can you make my shop sign? Put “Tom's Flowers” with an “Order” button to the right of it.
When someone presses Order, print “New order!” so I hear the bell. Ding!
My sketch is up on the sign board. Press Run whenever you want me to take a look!
celebration: Look at that Order button! My customers are going to love it.
thanks: It looks wonderful. Thank you — the shop is open!
request: Can you make my shop sign? Put "Tom's Flowers" with an "Order" button to the right of it. When someone presses Order, print "New order!" so I hear the bell.

criteria.description: The text "Tom's Flowers" is on screen

criteria.message: I need a button my customers can press.

criteria.description: The "Order" button is to the right of "Tom's Flowers"
criteria.message: Customers should read my name first, then see the button.
The sign looks lovely! But a customer pressed Order and my bell stayed quiet…
